coverage_notes: Sections 12.2 and 12.3 locally state controller and possible processor processing, respectively, but their operative privacy terms are in external policies or a DPA not supplied here; those external terms are excluded and are not inferred. The existing anchors identify these limitations but do not establish the contents of the referenced documents.

paragraph_audit.reason: Section 12.2 states that Mistral AI collects and Processes Customer Personal Data as controller in accordance with an external privacy policy, but that policy is not supplied. No local processing duty beyond that reference can be faithfully extracted.

Section 12.3 states that Mistral AI may process Personal Data on Customer’s behalf as processor when Customer uses the Products on Mistral Infrastructure, and that an external DPA applies. The DPA is not supplied, so its operative terms cannot be inferred.
